fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential psexec command that initiate execution on a remote systems via common commandline flags used by the utility
fields.name: Potential PsExec Remote Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "accepteula" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -u " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -p " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " \\\\") and (not (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\\\localhost" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\\\127."))))
